Market reasoning.opportunity_logic: The selected team must win. A strong individual performance or high combined score does not establish the game winner.
Market reasoning.projection_note: No central statistic forecast supplied; none invented.

This arithmetic assumes the saved probability belongs to this exact selection, line and price; a changed line requires model reanalysis. Push probability is not supplied, so this is not a push-adjusted expected-value estimate.
Market reasoning.scope: Exact-line arithmetic and explanatory scenarios, not a new prediction model or proof of profitability. Illustrations assume participation and final official stats; platform void/stat-correction rules can differ.
